scope: Explicit Nexus definitions, separate from original source observations

definitions.rationale: Nexus selects five base Nyame pieces, a fixed Moonbeam Cape, Loricate and Defending Ring. Uses Mpaca/Khonsu instead of Malignance Pole, retaining the same staff as casting/melee and its base Refresh; gives up the pole DT. Nyame legs replace the guide Agwu legs as its explicit unaugmented defensive alternative. Stikini replaces the chance-based Shadow Ring with base recovery/skill utility. No effective cap or safe tanking claim.

definitions.target: Refresh Idle — staff; no Sublimation charging
definitions.rationale: Build from the Refresh Idle Example: Mpaca, Homiliary, Befouled, Volte, Arbatel and two Stikini copies. Nexus takes Arbatel +3 body and retains defensive Nyame legs instead of Unity-dependent Assiduity, Loricate instead of citizenship-dependent Sibyl and Moonbeam. Sacrifices some maximum recovery for fewer conditional prerequisites; switch to defensive idle when threatened. This is gear Refresh, not casting Refresh or claiming spell Refresh stacks with Sublimation.

Complete the six-slot Sublimation reference with the defensive idle shell. Select Acad head, Peda body, Savant ear and Embla for charging. Deliberately omit Siriti and Woltaris: preserve the established staff and avoid a mission-ring choice. Reduced optimization versus every Sublimation item; no charge time, HP capacity or recovery total claimed.

definitions.target: General Fast Cast — no aligned-Arts bonus required
definitions.rationale: Use fixed base Fast Cast pieces and explicit Vanya D15/FC10 cape. Mpaca/Khonsu is legal; this does not repair or reattribute Alternative Fast Cast Hvergelmir/shield. Avoid random Merlinic and Quick Magic choices. No 80% attainment or cast/recast time claim; Regal Unity contribution remains conditional.

context.arts: Any; no Grimoire casting multiplier assumed

definitions.rationale: Replace the general head/feet with Peda mortarboard and Acad loafers for aligned-Arts spellcasting. These effects are conditional, not ordinary additive FC, and do not stack with casting-time stratagems per guide. No automatic overlay or timing formula implemented.

context.arts: Spell aligned with Light or Dark Arts

definitions.target: Aligned Arts precast — Celerity/Alacrity and matching weather
definitions.rationale: Use general FC head with Peda loafers for their weather-conditioned Celerity/Alacrity effect; omit incompatible Grimoire head/feet bonus assumptions. No reduction or recast result calculated. Source distinguishes these conditional categories.

definitions.target: Cure — Light Arts; no weather bonus required
definitions.rationale: Nexus combines base Daybreak, Arbatel body, Peda +3 healing/potency-II hands, Acad pants and Vanya B15 hood with support accessories. Ammurapi is a fixed enhancing/accuracy shield retained across support actions rather than a Sors potency copy; Moonbeam adds defense instead of a random cape. Two Stikini copies fill the rings for recovery/skill. No Kaykaus augments, Cure cap or MP-efficiency result assumed. Peda +3 is a deliberate exact tier, not the +4 live 378846 snapshot.

context.arts: Light Arts; single target Cure; Rapture inactive

definitions.rationale: Use the explicitly published light-weather weapon/cape/belt combination on the Nexus cure shell: Chatoyant, Khonsu, Twilight and Hachirin. Requires favorable light weather without conflicting day assumptions. Gives up Daybreak and defensive cape; no universal upgrade or multiplier total claimed.

context.weather: Light weather; no conflicting day bonus assumed

definitions.rationale: Replace Vanya head with exact Arbatel +3 for Rapture while keeping the weather-independent cure shell. Gives up Vanya skill/Conserve MP; conditional Rapture enhancement is not added as ordinary Cure potency. Spell access, charge and efficacy must be established in play.

Complete the source Cursna grid using Daybreak/Ammurapi and Pemphredo for omitted weapon/ammo slots. Retain Peda gown, Hieros, Haoma/Menelaus, Debilis, Meili/Beatific, Oretania and Bishop accessories with Vanya B15 head/feet. Menelaus negative FC is a midcast tradeoff. No augmented Gada, Doom removal guarantee or success percentage.

context.arts: Light Arts; Cursna, not ordinary -na or Cure

definitions.rationale: Complete the SU5 source support shell using legal Bolelabunga/Ammurapi instead of unspecified-rank Musa; no Musa or Gada duration bonus is claimed. Telchine duration10 head/legs/feet, Peda body and Arbatel hands remain explicit. Choose Pemphredo in omitted ammo for Conserve MP. Retain skill accessories and two Stikini copies. Gives up ranked Musa duration; no maximum-duration or skill-cap claim.

Complete the Bolelabunga/Ammurapi Regen core with skill/Conserve MP accessories and duplicate Stikini rings. Arbatel bonnet supplies the Regen objective; Telchine duration10 body/legs/feet, Arbatel hands and base Lugh cape preserve duration. No Regen potency augments or Musa C rank are inferred. No tick amount, duration or Light Arts bonus calculated.

Replace the Regen bonnet with Telchine duration10 head. Bolelabunga/shield is the explicit retained legal weapon pair instead of ranked Musa. Gives up bonnet potency for duration; not the source Max Duration composition or a numeric maximum.

Complete the partial Stoneskin accessory reference with the duration shell. Select Nodens, Earthcry, Siegel and Shedir explicitly; the latter replaces Telchine duration legs. Skill and effect accessories serve different purposes; no absorption cap or amount established.

Complete the partial Aquaveil reference with the duration shell, retaining Bolelabunga/shield rather than an unreviewed rod. Select base Amalric Coif +1, Regal Cuffs, Emphatikos and Shedir. No path A stats assumed; Aquaveil is in base head text. Hands give up Perpetuance enhancement; no 102% SIRD, interruption count or whole-party immunity claim.

context.stratagems: Accession only when deliberately used; no automatic AoE

definitions.rationale: Nexus uses Mpaca/Khonsu as the source-supported any-rank staff alternative and Pemphredo instead of a rank-dependent Ghastly. Base Agwu cap, Arbatel +3 body/hands/legs/feet, unranked Argute and Metamor are concrete minimums. Cape uses explicit INT20/MAcc20-MDmg20/MAB10 target augments, without dye/resin assumptions. Hachirin and Arbatel feet require matching weather/Klimaform. Gives up R30 bonuses; no source numeric caption or superiority imported.

context.weather: Matches element; Klimaform active; no conflicting day assumed

definitions.target: Magic burst — matching weather; no Ebullience
definitions.rationale: Use base Agwu hands/legs and Mujin Band for a burst-oriented alternative; retain Arbatel body/feet, staff and fixed ammo. No Agwu rank is required for the base burst properties; this deliberately falls below source R25/R30 equipment. No MBD cap or extra II augments assumed. Free nuke and burst remain distinct objectives.

Use Arbatel bonnet for Ebullience, base Agwu body/hands/legs and Mujin Band. Exact declared condition controls the head choice; no multiplicative enhancement or burst-cap formula is enabled. Retain fixed staff/ammo and explicitly selected cape minimums rather than unspecified ranks.

definitions.target: Free Helix II — non-light/dark; no burst
definitions.rationale: Assemble the free Helix objective with base Agwu body/hands/legs and Mallquis Ring. Choose Acuity +1 base instead of Hachirin: no ordinary weather multiplier is presumed for Helix. Unranked Argute Stole still has its base Helix-duration property. Mpaca is a fixed supported staff; specialized light/dark/wind affinity weapons are separate unclaimed contexts. No duration maximum or initial/DoT damage claim.

Use Peda mortarboard, base Agwu body/hands/legs and Mujin/Freke for the distinct burst Helix context. Replace source unknown-augment Arbatel earring with fixed Regal/Malignance and retain base Acuity rather than weather obi. Cape minimums are explicit. No assumed Sortie earring augments, max ranked armor or burst/duration totals.

Complete an accuracy-focused staff alternative using Mpaca/Khonsu, Acad head/body/hands/feet, Arbatel pants and two Stikini copies. Replace augment-dependent Aurist/Obstinate with the explicit magic cape and base Acuity. Gives up duration-focused Kishar/Regal Cuffs and possible Immunobreak legs. No guaranteed landing, all-school skill conversion or Light Arts equivalence.

Retain Mpaca staff/Khonsu for a legal known staff alternative, sacrificing Rubicundity potency. Select Pixie, Erra, Hirudinea/Mani, Evanescence/Archon, Peda pants and base Agwu feet from the source objective. Use fixed Arbatel body/hands instead of unspecified Merlinic +11 augments; base Bookworm cape and Acuity replace ambiguous Fucho activation. No assertion that affinity affects Aspir the same as Drain; no drain amount or recovery formula.

context.arts: Dark Arts; Drain/Aspir available; no burst

definitions.rationale: Adapt the Alacrity accuracy grid with Mpaca/Khonsu instead of unspecified Musa and the explicitly augmented cape. Keep Acad head/body/hands/pants, Peda feet, two Stikini and Witful. Weather/Alacrity foot effect is conditional; not a Grimoire casting-time stack. No recast number, stun lock or landing guarantee.

Use the source dark-affinity head/ring with base Agwu body/hands/legs/feet and fixed staff/ammo. This gives up specifically augmented Amalric pieces for known base effects. Require Tabula Rasa and favorable dark weather; no burst or duration calculation assumed. Separate from Drain/Aspir and Helix.

Adapt Engaged TP with fixed Mpaca/Khonsu instead of the published Gozuki pair and base Nyame head instead of augmented Blistering. Require Gazu R15 and DEX20/Acc20-Att20/STP10 cape; choose no unspecified Nyame path bonuses. Two Chirich copies. A support mage niche when safe to engage, not a dedicated-DD ranking or delay/accuracy cap.

context.role: Niche staff melee; SCH level 99; support duties take priority

definitions.rationale: Keep Mpaca/Khonsu but use five base Nyame pieces, Loricate, Defending and Moonbeam from defensive idle. Gives up Gazu/cape offense and one Chirich copy for fixed protective effects. Not a claim of capped DT or immunity, and no automated defense/weapon lock changes.

Replace base Nyame helm with Arbatel +3 bonnet and legs with Arbatel +3 pants for their explicit base accuracy/DEX, retaining Gazu R15, paired Chirich, Amar and accuracy cape. Gives up Nyame physical-defense/evasion properties; no accuracy/hit-rate or superiority claim. Exact alternatives are chosen by Nexus, not attributed to the author.

Use exact Mpaca/Khonsu rather than Khatvanga with five Nyame B15 targets and explicit INT20/WSD10 cape. Base Metamor, fixed Ishvara/Regal and Fotia accessories avoid a guessed Moonshade or unspecified rank. Multi-hit physical WS has distinct priorities from magical WS; no universal best, damage/TP-return or debuff-duration result is claimed. Requires unlocked/merited Shattersoul and sufficient staff skill.
